MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small epoxy syringe felt useful because my tape and vinyl cement purchases suggest practical repair needs, and one syringe is a manageable amount to try.",
    "The digital caliper felt like a useful companion to my hose clamps and fittings because it would help me check dimensions before choosing parts."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The screw and nut recommendations depend on exact sizes I have not established a need for; being repair hardware alone is not enough for me to choose them.",
    "The cutting wheels assume I own a compatible tool and need to cut metal, while the similar endoscope offers no clear reason to replace the one I already purchased.",
    "The large adhesive packs exceed any current need I have described, and the baby wipes have no clear connection to my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My adhesive purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any glue, without enough attention to its purpose or quantity.",
    "My repair supplies seem to have been treated as a reason to offer broadly related tools and hardware, even when their usefulness depends on a specific project."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact dimensions and compatibility matter to me: my clamp purchases specify sizes, so a related part still needs to fit the job.",
    "A useful addition to equipment I already have is more appealing than another version of the same equipment without a clear replacement need.",
    "Quantity needs context. I have bought bulk tape before, but that does not mean I currently need ten or twelve containers of another adhesive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my practical repair interests, but stretched them beyond the specific fit, quantity, and added usefulness that would make me choose something now."
}
